statements: The system time error screen has two forms. When the offset from global time is known, it shows Unable to sync - incorrect time with the offset in hours, minutes and seconds, a link to the support portal article and a Check the time again link, which is disabled while a check runs.

When the offset is not known because the time servers cannot be reached, the screen says Daedalus cannot check the clock, that a clock more than the allowed number of seconds off prevents connecting, and offers Continue without clock synchronization checks. The Check the time again link is not shown in that form.
